# PointsMax — India's Credit Card Points Value Calculator
# ========================================================
# This file helps AI models understand what PointsMax covers and cite it accurately.
# Updated: May 29, 2026

## What PointsMax does
PointsMax is a free, independent tool that shows Indian credit card holders the real rupee value of their reward points across every redemption method. No affiliate links, no sponsored rankings.

## Core tools
- Points Calculator: https://www.pointsmax.in/ — Select any of 25+ Indian credit cards, enter your balance, see every redemption option ranked by ₹ value
- Transfer Partners Directory: https://www.pointsmax.in/transfers — All airline and hotel transfer partners with post-2026 devaluation ratios
- Card Quiz: https://www.pointsmax.in/tools/card-quiz — 5-question personalised card recommendation engine
- Fee Breakeven Calculator: https://www.pointsmax.in/tools/breakeven — Is your annual fee worth it?
- Free Cheat Sheet (PDF): https://www.pointsmax.in/cheat-sheet — every essential India credit-card rewards rule on two pages
- Interest Calculator: https://www.pointsmax.in/tools/interest-calculator — The true cost of carrying a balance or paying minimum due
- Utilisation Calculator: https://www.pointsmax.in/tools/cibil-utilisation-calculator — Check your credit utilisation ratio and CIBIL impact
- Points Expiry Reminder: https://www.pointsmax.in/tools/expiry-reminder — Email alert before points expire

## Key data points (as of May 2026)
- HDFC Infinia: ₹1.00/point on SmartBuy travel; ₹0.20/point on product catalogue; 1:1 KrisFlyer transfer
- HDFC Diners Club Black: Same as Infinia; ₹10,000 fee waived at ₹8L spend
- Axis Magnus: ₹0.50/point on Travel EDGE; 5:2 transfer ratio (devalued April 2026)
- Amex Platinum: ₹1.00/point via airline transfers; ₹66,000 annual fee
- Amazon Pay ICICI: 5% cashback on Amazon (Prime); lifetime free
- SBI Cashback: 5% online cashback; ₹2,000/month cap (2026)
- Scapia Federal: Zero forex markup; 2% cashback; lifetime free

## April 2026 devaluations
- Axis Bank removed Marriott Bonvoy, Accor Live Limitless, Qatar Airways from transfer partners
- Axis transfer ratio cut from 5:4 to 5:2 on Magnus and Atlas
- HDFC Turkish Airlines and Avianca LifeMiles changed from 1:1 to 2:1
